note: Submodule of commerce_stripe. Logs Stripe webhooks to the commerce_stripe_webhook_event DB table; overview UI at /admin/commerce/config/stripe-webhook-events (route commerce_stripe_webhook_event.overview, perm 'view commerce stripe webhook event'); purge-confirm route perm 'purge commerce stripe webhook event'. Config object commerce_stripe_webhook_event.settings has retention_time (default 2592000s) and queue (bool). Async processing uses AdvancedQueue job type commerce_stripe_webhook_event / queue worker commerce_stripe_webhook_event_processor. Statuses: 0 unprocessed / 1 succeeded / 2 failed / 3 skipped. All medium/hard cases are grounded in the local settings config (no Stripe API).

evals.prompt: The commerce_stripe_webhook_event submodule is enabled. Where in the admin UI do I go to review the Stripe webhook events it has logged?
evals.expected_output: The overview is at /admin/commerce/config/stripe-webhook-events (route commerce_stripe_webhook_event.overview, permission 'view commerce stripe webhook event'); each row links to a details page and there is a purge-processed-events confirm form.

evals.prompt: How do I make commerce_stripe_webhook_event process webhook events asynchronously through a queue instead of during the request, and which config object controls that?
evals.expected_output: Enable the 'queue' setting in the config object commerce_stripe_webhook_event.settings (queue: true). Then events are processed via the AdvancedQueue job type commerce_stripe_webhook_event (queue worker commerce_stripe_webhook_event_processor) instead of synchronously. retention_time (default 2592000) controls how long processed events are kept.

evals.prompt: What two permissions does commerce_stripe_webhook_event define, and what does each gate?
evals.expected_output: 'view commerce stripe webhook event' gates the overview and details pages; 'purge commerce stripe webhook event' gates the purge-processed-events confirm form. Both are restrict access: true.

evals.prompt: On this site, commerce_stripe_webhook_event has a customised retention period. Inspect the live config and tell me the retention time, in seconds, for processed webhook events.

Is this site configured to process Stripe webhook events synchronously or asynchronously via a queue? Inspect the commerce_stripe_webhook_event configuration and report the value of its queue setting.
evals.expected_output: The 'queue' setting is true, so events are processed asynchronously via AdvancedQueue (commerce_stripe_webhook_event.settings:queue = true).

evals.prompt: Configure commerce_stripe_webhook_event so that processed Stripe webhook events are retained for only 1 day (86400 seconds). Apply the change to the live site.
Configure commerce_stripe_webhook_event to process incoming Stripe webhook events asynchronously through the AdvancedQueue-backed queue, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: commerce_stripe_webhook_event.settings:queue == true (drush config:set commerce_stripe_webhook_event.settings queue 1). Events are then processed via the AdvancedQueue job type commerce_stripe_webhook_event.
